title: Poker Now Session Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: BoardGameGeek plays (`bgg:play`), Poker Now sessions (`pokernow:session`), Bridge Base Online boards (`bridgebase:board`), and Lichess tournament rounds (`lichess:tournament`).
app: BoardGameGeek play logs, Poker Now session exports, Bridge Base Online boards, and Lichess tournament data ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pokernow:session
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by table_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>168
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when Poker Now session data has stopped arriving for a given table name.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per table name and alert when the feed is older than 168 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It measures when one part of your Poker Now session feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
